description: Calculate DCED-compliant attributable Net Additional Income (NAI), deadweight, displacement, substitution, systemic copycat crowding-in, and full-time equivalent (FTE) employment.

additional_labor_days_per_beneficiary.description: Extra casual on-farm labor days demanded per year.

crowding_in_multiplier.description: Ratio capturing competitor imitation (1.0 = none, 1.25 = 25% copycat expansion).

deadweight_pct.description: Adoption percentage that would have occurred without the project (0-100%).

direct_partner_jobs_created.description: Salaried jobs created by commercial lead firm.

displacement_pct.description: Income gains displacing existing local businesses (0-100%).

gross_additional_income_per_beneficiary.description: Annual gross income increase per adopter ($/yr).

program_intervention_cost.description: Total donor budget allocated to intervention ($).

substitution_pct.description: Forgone income from abandoned alternative crops (0-100%).

working_days_per_fte.description: Benchmark workdays per full-time equivalent job.

name: calculate_dced_attribution
